content: {"like":["Enjoys Gattaca’s realistic sci‑fi vision over other low‑budget sci‑fi films","Prefers well‑executed martial arts choreography in classic Shaw Brothers titles","Values honor and courtesy themes in Hong Kong martial arts dramas","Appreciates engaging, quirky storytelling in kung‑fu action movies","Likes well‑balanced fight scenes that avoid excessive gimmicks"],"dislike":["Dislikes low‑budget kung‑fu flicks with mediocre fight sequences","Avoids films that rely on corny gimmicks for fight scenes","Rejects portrayals of Japanese fighters as animalistic in Chinese cinema","Dislikes repetitive one‑armed hero tropes","Shuns 1980s Hong Kong comedy style with silly slapstick and juvenile sexual references"]}
